title: somatomotor
description: A multi-modal neuroimaging dataset combining structural MRI, MEG, and EEG recordings from multiple subjects during a somatosensory-motor task. Participants received electrical stimulation of the right median nerve at the wrist and responded by lifting the left index finger as quickly as possible. This dataset enables investigation of sensorimotor integration and the neural mechanisms underlying somatosensory perception and motor response generation.
methods_description: Data collection involved electrical stimulation of the right median nerve at the wrist with concurrent MEG and EEG recordings. Anatomical fiducials (nasion, left and right pre-auricular points) were digitized for MEG-MRI co-registration. Structural T1-weighted MRI was acquired for each subject. Task triggers (somatosensory stimulus at 32 Hz and finger lift response at 16 Hz) were recorded in MEG .fif files and corresponding events .tsv files.
